Level 5 - Interview-ready 60 min Amazon Flipkart Atlassian Self-grading

Mock LLD Interviews: Full Walkthroughs

Three complete mock rounds, one per round type: an Amazon-style 55-minute OOD (object-oriented design) discussion, a Flipkart-style 90-120 minute machine-coding round, and an Atlassian-style 60-minute code design round. Each has the prompt, a minute-by-minute script, strong vs weak answers, working code that compiles and runs, the follow-ups, and a sheet to grade yourself.
